title: flags/config.json
description: The static settings of the Flags SDK. The framework plugins, the CLI and the runtime read this file.

selfSource.description: The default source self. An application which depends on @vercel/flags-core has the source self with the flags of its Vercel project, also without flags/sources/self/, and the code generation loads these flags from Vercel Flags. false turns it off.

overrides.description: Which override tokens the SDK accepts, e.g. from Flags Explorer. By default, the SDK accepts tokens of the shared secret FLAGS_SECRET, and on Vercel or with a linked project the tokens which Vercel signs.

secret.description: false: accept no tokens of the shared secret. The secret itself comes only from the environment variable FLAGS_SECRET.

vercel.description: Tokens which Vercel signs. true, false, or options which also accept the tokens outside of Vercel.

issuer.description: The trusted issuer of the tokens. Must use HTTPS. The default is the issuer of the Vercel Toolbar.

jwksUrl.description: Where the public keys of the issuer are. Must use HTTPS. The default is <issuer>/jwks.json.

project.description: The Vercel project. The default comes from the environment: VERCEL_PROJECT_ID and VERCEL_TARGET_ENV on Vercel, the OIDC token or .vercel/project.json locally.

maxLifetimeSeconds.description: The maximum lifetime of a token in seconds. The default is 7 days.

cacheMaxAgeMs.description: How long the public keys stay valid in the cache.

cooldownMs.description: The minimum time between two loads for a key which is not known.

allowInsecureLocalhost.description: Allows http://localhost for the issuer and the keys. Only for a local test issuer.
